name: Steal Or Die [MASSIVE HALLOWEEN UPD!]
desc:
🔦Escape the monster,  steal loot — or BE the monster

You have minutes to loot the building. Something is hunting you the whole time.

💰 STEAL — 37 items to grab, from phones to gold bars. The rarer the loot, the bigger the payout… and the slower you run.
🚪 HIDE — closets, vents, barricaded doors. It hears your footsteps. It hears your voice.
👹 OR BE THE MONSTER — play as the entity and hunt your friends.

[VERSION 1.6]: VC ONLY SERVERS ARE HERE!

🚨AI Assistance Disclosure: AI tools were utilized to assist with UI development, bug fixes, and optimization, as the game is developed and maintained by a solo developer.

🥽 FULL VR SUPPORT
📱 FULL PHONE & TABLET SUPPORT
🖥️ PC
🎮 CONSOLE

CREDIT: The Locust is an original character by Doctor Nowhere. This is a high-effort fan tribute; the model was made by me out of respect for his work.

Bring friends. Don't trust them. 

👍 Like and favourite for updates!
